item.title: Bulletin updated at 23:20 HKT 06/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be generally fine over southern China in the next few days. It will be hot and the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong midweek next week, it will be cloudier over the region.
